decisions.reason: The source explicitly concerns keyword entry and KDP uploading, not the content, design, review, or responsibility for the paperback cover.
The specific laptop-guided KDP workflow is owned by the KDP submission Requirement; it does not change the candidate's broader publication-readiness guidance state.
Guidance for keyword entry and KDP upload does not alter the copyright-page publisher attribution or its presentation.
The source does not change chapter-image inclusion, placement, integration timing, or full-page treatment.
The requested KDP keyword and upload guidance does not modify the manuscript's editorial objective or approved textual revisions.
The source contains no decision about Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, capitalization, punctuation, or line treatment.
The KDP guidance delivery mode does not alter requirements concerning image aspect ratio, cropping, or pixelation.
The source does not address the title-page newline artifact or any other title-page content or layout behavior.
The source does not change the chapter-image review material, mapping basis, selection, tone, or colour-palette criteria.
The requested guidance for keywords and KDP uploading does not change which client-edited manuscript revision is authoritative.
